site.name: Artek
site.description: Artek — premium printing and art finishing solutions in Guatemala: ChromaLuxe aluminum, acrylic, fine art paper, large-format and custom wall art.
hero.headline: Your images, elevated into art
hero.lead: High-end printing and finishing on aluminum, acrylic and fine art paper for residential, commercial, hospitality and artistic spaces.
intro.title: Printing technology in service of art
intro.body: We work with high-end materials and advanced technologies to create sophisticated visual pieces. Every project is produced to order, with obsessive attention to color, detail and finish.
services.title: What we do
services.intro: We produce every piece to order, combining high-end materials with advanced printing technology. These are our services.
portfolio.title: Selected work
portfolio.intro: A selection of pieces produced for residential, commercial and hospitality clients. Filter by finish.
why.title: Made to last
why.1.title: Innovation
why.1.body: Materials and techniques that take your images beyond the ordinary and give every space character.
why.2.title: Color quality
why.2.body: Exceptional color performance, deep contrast and a unique three-dimensional effect.
why.3.title: Premium materials
why.3.body: High-end, acid-free, archival substrates built to last for generations.
why.4.title: Advanced technology
why.4.body: State-of-the-art printing equipment operated with artisanal precision.
cta.title: Have a project in mind?
cta.body: Tell us what you envision and we'll advise you on materials, formats and finishes.
about.title: Who we are
about.lead: Artek is a Guatemalan company specializing in premium printing and art finishing solutions. We work with high-end materials and advanced technologies to create sophisticated visual pieces for residential, commercial, hospitality and artistic spaces.
about.mission_body: To serve with the latest in printing technology applied to photography, digital art decoration and product promotion, providing our clients with different options tailored to their needs.
about.vision_body: To be the benchmark for photographic printing on innovative materials, distinguished by personalized work of the highest quality for local and international markets.
about.value_excellence_body: Every piece is produced with the same level of attention and care, regardless of format or budget.
about.value_honesty_body: We advise our clients transparently, recommending the material and technique that best suits their project.
about.value_quality_body: We use only top-tier materials and state-of-the-art equipment to guarantee superior results.
about.value_precision_body: We respect agreed timelines because we know every project has a date and a space waiting for it.
contact.title: Let's talk about your project
contact.lead: Tell us what you envision. We'll advise you on materials, formats and finishes with no commitment.
